resources.string: If you see this, notifications work.
Make sure you are on the same Wi-Fi and the bridge is running on the computer.
Allow this app to install updates

1) Install YouTube Music on the computer and sign in.
2) Add --remote-debugging-port=9223 to the app shortcut once. Run setup.bat on the computer and it does this for you.
3) Start the bridge: arka-plan.vbs, or python bridge.py in a terminal.
4) Phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.
5) Type the bridge address in the box below. The bridge prints it when it starts, for example http://192.168.1.50:8777
If it still will not connect, allow Python through the Windows firewall on private networks.

TuneDeck %s
Phone remote for YouTube Music on your computer. Unofficial, not affiliated with Google.
